posts.description: The Pudding explains ideas debated in culture with visual essays. We’re not chasing current events or clickbait. We choose topics where visuals inform and entertain. The Pudding is such a brilliant website. I spent hours yesterday going through different essays. Unique/curious topics. Wonderful, creative presentation.

📚 Finished reading: A Deadly Episode by Anthony Horowitz ⭐️⭐️⭐️ I enjoyed the book—it never got boring. But is it a great mystery? I can’t say that. The plot is too thin and hence needed two different ones, connected eventually, albeit. That means none of the central characters in either is fleshed out. It almost felt like two independent murder mysteries, stitched conveniently to fit into a book.
Podcasts are the pickle ball of journalism. Wow! From Vir Das .
